description: We build an intuitive web app for the Lunar Landing Site Navigator challenge: compare south-pole landing sites and dates in seconds, showing when a site is lit and when Earth is visible for communication. Built on real ephemeris data so every number is checkable, with plain-language explanations for planners, educators and the public. Our team has hackathon experience in data dashboards and AI tools and is aiming for a polished, working demo.
